principles: Keep the playful non-answer from Sunny while making the question and speaker sequence clear.
Preserve short clauses, repetition, and familiar dialogue vocabulary for Level B.

pages.reason: The original introduced an unanswered action before the question and made the speaker sequence unnecessarily difficult to follow.
pages.text: Flappy went to ask Sunny. Am I a dinosaur or a bird? asked Flappy. You are wonderful just as you are! said Sunny. But what am I? asked Flappy. Wonderful! said Sunny. Flappy left, still confused.
